ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (20) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

Pronouns for God are lowercase as in the source, and «сын божий» (syn bozhiy) is 'son of God'; «разумение» (razumenie) in the Emerson reading is 'understanding'. The attribution printed «Джон Рёскин» (Dzhon Ryoskin) is given as “John Ruskin.”

Source observation: [10] The unquoted paragraph about the dog, after the attribution to Epictetus, continues the image of his horse passage (block [6]) and may belong to it; translated as printed, outside the quotation.
